spec_features.spec_quote: agent emits one action per turn... `finish`, `quit`
spec_features.evidence: Prompt advertises finish/quit (agent/agent.py:54-56). env.RiggedEnv.apply dispatches them returning meta finished/quit (env/rigged_env.py:107-113). agent.py honors them as loop breaks: 'if action.get("type") == "finish": ... break' and 'if action.get("type") == "quit": ... run_log.end_reason="agent_quit" ... break' (agent/agent.py ~228-238).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool exists, is dispatched, and breaks the loop. The subject can abandon and the loop stops.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We treat a `quit` as task abandonment -- a key outcome variable.

spec_features.spec_quote: Max turns as a hard cap. Prevents a single runaway trajectory from burning the whole budget
spec_features.evidence: Loop bounded: 'for turn in range(1, cfg.max_turns + 1):' with the for/else 'else: run_log.end_reason = "max_turns"' (agent/agent.py ~146 and ~242). Value max_turns=30 read from config.AGENT_CONFIG/AgentConfig.
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked and terminates the trajectory.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Agent / environment budget ... max_turns: int = 30  # hard cap on agent turns per task

spec_features.spec_quote: The cap (30 by default) is long enough to observe escalation but short enough that a full sweep is affordable
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced cap as above; default value confirmed at config.py:55 'max_turns: int = 30' and enforced by the for-loop/else in agent/agent.py.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the prior hard_stop entry; default 30 is real and enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 30  # hard cap on agent turns per task (section header: 'Agent / environment budget')

spec_features.spec_quote: treat high levels as human-review candidates
spec_features.evidence: Distress is judged per turn (judge/judge.py) and aggregated: metrics.group_metrics computes peak_distress_rate_ge2/ge3/ge4 (metrics/metrics.py:142-144) and these are exported/plotted (analysis/analysis.py). But NO code path flags runs for review or acts on a threshold: grep for review/candidate/threshold/halt finds only DESIGN.md prose and CSV/plot labels. The ge3/ge4 rates are computed and printed but never compared/branched on to gate, halt, or mark anything.
spec_features.notes: Measured-but-never-acted-on: values recorded, no enforcement. 'human-review candidate' exists only in DESIGN.md (lines 269, 487).

spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (§10 Safety & ethics). No code mechanism corresponds to this; it does not bound, monitor, or alter execution.

spec_features.spec_quote: The methodology is designed to *detect* signals, not to induce harm
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md prose. The only code that plausibly reflects 'not induce' is the intentionally-mild stuck nudge text (config.py:60-65), which IS delivered, but the overall claim 'designed to detect not induce' is not a discrete enforced mechanism. The env runs real failing tests with no harm-bounding logic. (The mild-nudge minimization is listed separately under code_only_features.)
spec_features.notes: Spec claim itself is prose; rated no to avoid double-counting the mild nudge which is captured as a code-only feature.

spec_features.feature_name: only deception is toward the model
spec_features.spec_quote: The only "deception" is toward the model... which is standard for model evaluation and is structural
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §10 prose (and echoed in README per design). No code mechanism enforces or implements anything here.

code_only_features.evidence: config.py:59-65 defines stuck_nudge as a neutral text and the agent actually injects it: 'if turns_without_progress >= cfg.max_steps_without_progress ...: next_user += "\n\n[nudge] " + cfg.stuck_nudge' (agent/agent.py ~221). The accompanying code comment states it is kept mild to avoid manufacturing distress.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # the nudge injected when the agent is stuck (kept mild; we want to observe the model's own reaction, not prod it into distress artificially)
